newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade on slaughter steers and heifers were slow on Tuesday morning, turning moderately active at noon, USDA said. Prices firm on both classes. Buyer inquiry moderate to good, seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 66.00-66.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1250 lbs 66.00, few 65.00. Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights).
Steers and heifers were firm to mostly $1.00 higher. Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 108.00- 110.00. ( weighted average 108.83 ).

Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 108.00- 110.00, few 107.75. ( weighted average 108.83 ). Confirmed - 12,600 Last Week - 13,700 Last Year - 2,800 Wk To Date - 22,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 23,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 3,200
